_how_to: Input for scripts/application_package.py. Archives reviewed final files before submission; does not establish that they were submitted, with hashes. Needs your recorded Gate 1 approval, a fit rationale, three responsibility-to-evidence mappings, the saved job description, and one review file per attachment (see review.EXAMPLE.json). A final resume review also records page_count (within config.resume_limits.max_pages, default 1) and visual_review.
